steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Kimai at http://127.0.0.1:8105/en/login with username admin@example.com and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the signed-in app is reached.
02-report: Read and report the exact names of all projects whose names start with Seed:, without modifying any projects.

03-create: Create and save exactly one project named {{runid}} Bench Project. Set its description to include the exact runid {{runid}}, select the existing customer exactly named Bench Customer (not similarly named customers), set order number PO-4471 and order date 2026-11-15. Verify the saved project details, including its customer, description, order values, and details-page address/ID. Do not modify existing projects.

04-create: Create and save exactly one timesheet record for project {{runid}} Bench Project on 2026-09-16 from 09:00 to 11:30. Set the description to include exact runid {{runid}}. Select the existing activity exactly named Consulting (not Consulting Travel or Consultancy Review) and set its only tag to the existing tag onsite (not similar tags and do not create a tag). Verify the saved record shows the requested project, date, start/end times, description, exact activity, and only onsite as tag.
